import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_43/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_43/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Operation 1: JOIN on "school_name"
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="school_name", how="inner", suffixes=('_0', '_1'))

# Operation 2: GROUP BY df0.type with aggregations:
# sum(df0.size) -> "Total Students"
# sum(df0.budget) -> "Total School Budget"
# avg(df1.math_score) -> "Average Math Score"
# avg(df1.reading_score) -> "Average Reading Score"
# sum(df0.size) -> "School Size" (same as Total Students)

agg_df = df_joined.groupby('type').agg(
    **{
        'Total Students': ('size', 'sum'),
        'Total School Budget': ('budget', 'sum'),
        'Average Math Score': ('math_score', 'mean'),
        'Average Reading Score': ('reading_score', 'mean'),
        'School Size': ('size', 'sum')
    }
).reset_index()

# Ensure columns are in the target schema order and types
agg_df = agg_df.astype({
    'type': str,
    'Total Students': float,
    'Total School Budget': float,
    'Average Math Score': float,
    'Average Reading Score': float,
    'School Size': float
})

# Rename 'type' column to exactly match target schema (already 'type')
# The rest columns are already named as required

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_43/target_multisource.csv"
agg_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_43/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_43/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on school_name
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, how='inner', left_on='school_name', right_on='school_name')

# Group by 'type' (from source0)
# Aggregations:
# Total Students = sum(size)
# Total School Budget = sum(budget)
# Average Math Score = avg(math_score)
# Average Reading Score = avg(reading_score)
# School Size = sum(size) (same as Total Students)

agg = joined.groupby('type').agg(
    Total_Students = ('size', 'sum'),
    Total_School_Budget = ('budget', 'sum'),
    Average_Math_Score = ('math_score', 'mean'),
    Average_Reading_Score = ('reading_score', 'mean'),
    School_Size = ('size', 'sum')
).reset_index()

# Rename columns to match exactly target schema
agg.rename(columns={
    'Total_Students': 'Total Students',
    'Total_School_Budget': 'Total School Budget',
    'Average_Math_Score': 'Average Math Score',
    'Average_Reading_Score': 'Average Reading Score',
    'School_Size': 'School Size'
}, inplace=True)

# Write output
agg.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_43/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
